/ PRIVACY AND COOKIES

Privacy and cookies

This notice explains what the Olympic Cafe website collects, why, and the choices you have. We keep it short because we collect very little.

Last updated 10 November 2026.

Who we are

Olympic Cafe, 257 High Street, Waltham Cross, EN8 7BE, is responsible for this website and the personal data described here. You can reach us on 01992 631 555, by email at info@olympiccafe.co.uk, or in person at the cafe.

Google Analytics, only if you accept

We'd like to know how many people visit the site and which pages they use, so we can improve it. For that we use Google Analytics, but only if you click Accept on the cookie banner. Until then, nothing is sent to Google and no analytics cookies are set.

If you accept, Google Analytics records things like the pages you view, roughly where you are (town or region, not your address), the device and browser you use, how you arrived at the site, and taps on our call, directions and menu buttons. It does not record your name, and Google Analytics does not store your full IP address. We have switched off advertising features, so this data is not used to show you ads.

Google processes this data for us and may handle it outside the UK, under safeguards approved for UK data. We keep analytics data for 14 months. Our legal basis is your consent, which you can withdraw at any time.

Cookies and storage we use

oc-consentKept for 12 months
Remembers whether you accepted or rejected analytics, so we don't ask on every page. Stored in your browser, never sent to us.
_gaKept for 2 years
Google Analytics: tells one visit from another. Only set if you accept.
_ga_RKBW4QZWJEKept for 2 years
Google Analytics: keeps track of your current visit. Only set if you accept.

(also under Cookie settings at the bottom of every page). If you reject analytics after accepting, we delete the Google Analytics cookies from your browser.

Google Maps

Our contact page shows a Google map, and our directions links open Google Maps. When the map loads, or you follow a directions link, Google receives your IP address and may set its own cookies. Google's use of that data is covered by Google's privacy policy.

Hosting

The website is hosted by GitHub Pages. Like most web hosts, GitHub records visitors' IP addresses in its server logs to keep the service secure. We don't see or use those logs. Our legal basis is our legitimate interest in running a secure website.

If you contact us

If you phone or email us, we use what you tell us only to reply to you, and we don't keep it longer than we need to. We never sell or share your details for marketing.

Your rights

You can ask us for a copy of the personal data we hold about you, ask us to correct or delete it, or object to how we use it. Contact us using the details above. If you're not happy with how we've handled your data, you can complain to the Information Commissioner's Office at ico.org.uk.
